types.name: 口播
types.hint: 一个人对镜头持续说话，向观众输出观点、知识、经验或讲故事；不推销商品。仅摆姿势、对嘴型、跟音乐做手势、小孩玩闹不算口播。
types.hint_en: One person talks to camera, sharing opinions, knowledge, experience or a story; no selling. Requires sustained audible talking to the audience — a person merely posing, gesturing to music, lip-syncing, or a child playing is NOT a monologue. Others may appear on screen or interject briefly: still a monologue if ONE voice carries the content throughout.

types.name: 带货口播
types.hint: 对镜头推销商品：常见商品特写、价格/优惠字幕、购物车引导、"点击左下角链接"类话术。
types.hint_en: A person pitches products to camera: product close-ups, price/discount overlays, shopping-cart prompts, buy-link calls to action.

types.name: 访谈
types.hint: 两人或多人在问答/对话，有明确的采访者与被访者关系（含播客对谈形态）。
types.hint_en: Two or more people in alternating question-and-answer exchanges with interviewer and guest roles, including podcast-style dialogue. One person talking continuously while others sit nearby and listen is a monologue, NOT an interview.

types.name: 解说
types.hint: 画外音解说覆盖在游戏、影视或其他素材上，解说本身是内容主体。有解说的游戏/影视一律归此类。
types.hint_en: Voice-over narration is the main content over game, film or other footage. Narrated gameplay or film clips belong here, not gameplay.

types.name: 教学·录屏
types.hint: 分步骤教学或操作演示：桌面/手机录屏、软件界面、代码编辑器、PPT 翻页讲解。
types.hint_en: Step-by-step teaching or how-to demonstration: desktop or phone screen recording, app UI, code editor, slide walkthrough.

types.name: 剧情
types.hint: 无画外音解说的剧情短片、影视切片或实拍情景剧，靠画面、表演与台词叙事。
types.hint_en: Scripted story, film/TV clip or staged skit without voice-over narration; the plot is carried by scenes, acting and dialogue.

types.name: 唱歌
types.hint: 唱歌、翻唱、说唱表演，演唱或音乐本身是内容主体（含清唱与乐器弹唱）。
types.hint_en: The person(s) audibly perform the song themselves (vocal cover or performance is the content). Background music playing while someone talks, poses or dances is NOT singing.

types.name: 舞蹈
types.hint: 舞蹈、手势舞、走秀等肢体表演，动作本身是内容主体；常配热门音乐。
types.hint_en: Dance, hand-gesture dance, catwalk or other body-movement performance, usually set to trending music. Includes hand-gesture dances performed to camera with stickers/effects, even if the performer also lip-syncs.

types.name: 游戏
types.hint: 游戏画面实况/录屏：无解说，或解说只是随意闲聊而非内容主体。
types.hint_en: Raw game footage or livestream clips: no narration, or narration is casual chatter rather than the content itself.

types.name: 纯音乐画面
types.hint: 音乐驱动的画面混剪：风景、卡点、氛围/治愈系画面，无人声内容承载。
types.hint_en: Music-driven visual montage: scenery, beat-synced edits, ambience or mood visuals with no speech content.

types.name: 其他
types.hint: 以上类型都不符合的新形态。
types.hint_en: None of the listed types fits; a new content form.
